newsitem.title: USA: Westinghouse media unit to be called CBS Corp.
newsitem.headline: Westinghouse media unit to be called CBS Corp.

text.p: Westinghouse Electric Corp said Wednesday it had chosen a familiar name for its media business: "CBS Corp."
The company had been reviewing potential names after it announced last year that it was separating its media and industrial businesses. That move is expected to take place later this year.

CBS Corp will be made up of the CBS television network, Group W Satellite Communications Co, a cable television marketing and distribution company, and Infinity Broadcasting Corp, which was recently acquired by Westinghouse.

"As we considered a range of alternative corporate names, we spoke with our public -- our customers, employees and the financial community," Westinghouse Chairman and Chief Executive Michael Jordan said in a statement.

"The advice always came back: keep the name that has been known as a leader of the broadcasting industry from its earliest days, a name that has the power of a brand recognized worldwide for quality news and entertainment," he said.
